items.title: CF衰减与CP/Deep Bond升级树
items.original_rules: CF上限Lv9，CP/Deep Bond Lv100；Lv2后可升级；CF不互动会衰减，CP/Bond不衰减；终止不清亲密但7天不能再互申。

evidence_refs.text: After Lv. 2, a CF can be upgraded to a Couple or a deeper Bond
CF relationships can reach up to Lv. 9. CP and Deep Bond relationships can reach up to Lv. 100
The intimacy points of your CF Relationship will decay without interaction. Activate CP/Bond to prevent decay.
Protected by Couple or Deep Bond privileges, Intimacy will not decrease

After the relationship is terminated 
 1. Both parties can no longer apply for the relationship to each other within 7 days 
 2. The intimacy won't be cleared. 
 3. All keepsakes will become invalid. 
 Click confirm to terminate the relationship.

items.reconstruction_choices: 每10亲密升1级、CF日减2为自定；CP/Bond不衰减、9/100上限、7天冷却按文案。

items.title: 关系信物类型与失效修复
items.original_rules: 戒CP；包表Best Friend等深关系；花CF；CP转出锁戒；失效信物付原价50%恢复但不增亲密/魅力。

evidence_refs.text: Rings are used to form Couple relationships. Watches and bags are used to form Best Friend/Confidant/Brother/Sister/Brother & Sister relationships. Flowers are used to form Close Friend relationships
Rings can only be sent to your CP. Bags and watches can be sent to your CP and Deep Bonds. Flowers can be sent to all relationships
This relationship used to be a CP relationship, and the CP-exclusive ring keepsakes will be locked
To restore an invalid keepsake, you need to pay 50% of the original keepsake price in coins. And it will not increase the relationship intimacy and the recipient's charm value.
* Building a relationship will consume keepsake
*Switching relationship will consume keepsake

items.reconstruction_choices: 信物原价20、成长10；修复10且不重复亲密/魅力；转出戒锁不得修复为本地清晰选择。
not_recovered: 具体售价、每日上限、哪些转移失效、修复后有效期未知。
是否在目标地区/账号开启、真实后台裁决与付费权限未经运行验证。

evidence_refs.text: After two users form a CP, they may obtain a Limited Relationship Card for both characters through events or other means. Either user can gift the card to the other. Once gifted, it will appear in both users' Intimate Space, profiles, and other locations.

Displaying this Relationship Card again costs 50% of its price in coins. You will also receive 50% of its original Intimacy points and Flower points.
